title: Biphasic dissolving microneedles with cyclodextrin inclusion complexes for enhanced delivery of poorly soluble drugs
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,8266-8277
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08424E, Paper

Runze Wang, Jiaqi Cao, Jing Zou, Rui Zhang, Mengmeng Li, Wanglong Zhang, Mintong Guo
A biphasic dissolving microneedle platform integrating HP-β-cyclodextrin inclusion complexes enables high drug loading and efficient transdermal delivery of poorly soluble drugs, supporting improved bioavailability and translational potential.
